info.name: DroneDeploy GraphQL API
info.description: GraphQL API for the DroneDeploy drone mapping, reality capture, and aerial analytics platform. Single endpoint https://www.dronedeploy.com/graphql (POST), authenticated with an Authorization: Bearer <api_key> header (Enterprise / Developer Partner accounts only). Queries are rooted at `viewer` and objects are fetched by `node(id)`; results use Relay cursor pagination (first/after, pageInfo, edges/node). Requests marked (modeled) approximate operations not shown verbatim in the public docs.
